_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language on Deovandski's site, so they are always spelled the same. Names are written by sound, never translated (the author's rule). #HusbandOutWorld names come from HusbandOutWorld's content/i18n/it/glossary.json, which is the source: the names below are copied from it for the ones this site uses. Correct a series name there and here together, and look up any other series name there. Add this site's own names here the first time you translate them.
rule: Series names follow HusbandOutWorld's rule for this language: Story names stay exactly as in English, as in Portuguese, Spanish, Malay, German and Vietnamese. That includes coined world terms written as names: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People, Sand Worms, Fost Stone, Nari Refresher, Red Winga, Sapphire, Pearl). Plain words around them are translated into Italian and follow Italian word order (gel nari, pietre nari, bombe nari, interfaccia Darfaries, avventuriero Sapphire). Kingdoms read 'Regno di Sanbi', guards 'guardie di Forway'. The currency balls is 'palle' (singular 'palla'), which keeps the double meaning exactly; the rank follows it (palla sapphire, palle pearl). The unit timehunk stays as is. The reader is addressed as 'tu' everywhere, matching the author's casual voice; profanity is kept. Dates put the day first: '994 A.G. Adrian 6th' becomes '6 Adrian 994 A.G.' (the 1st is '1º'); with a weekday, 'Gannday, 14 Paulin 1039 A.G.'. Gregorian dates read '1º giugno 2020'. Category labels that are shared between pages use forms that fit any gender: Amichevoli, Ostili, Sulla difensiva. 'Sanbi shit!' (the Sanbi oath) is always 'Vecchia anima di Sanbi!' ('Old Sanbi soul!'), the author's rule; 'Sanbi shit out of luck' becomes 'Ti resterà solo la sfiga, vecchia anima di Sanbi!'. Standard Italian spelling.
site_rules: Real people and pets stay in Latin letters: Deovandski, Deo, and every family member, friend and pet named on the site (Peeta, Bidu, Fluffy).
Brand, company and product names stay as they are (Wizard Deo Solutions, Microsoft, Dynamics 365 F&O, GitHub, LinkedIn).

Titles in the top-39 lists (games, anime, TV, movies), concerts and theater (Deo's answer on #87): use the official title in this language. Movies and TV shows use their official local title; if none exists, keep the English one. Anime keeps the 'Romaji (local title)' structure; in Japanese, show the official Japanese title.
Anything marked translate="no" (Vraki-typeface text, names in a logo, code) stays as it is.
Every tab is translated, Lust, Tattoo and Mentor included (Deo's answer on #87).
